Native Salesforce observations from an isolated scratch org, using anonymous Apex and named tests at matching source and transport APIs 62.0 and 67.0. A custom object had Number formula fields of declared scale 2: blank=Num__c + 1 with BlankAsBlank; zero=Num__c + 1 with BlankAsZero; rounded=ROUND(Num__c / 3, 2) with BlankAsBlank; value=IF(ISBLANK(Text__c), 0, VALUE(Text__c)) with BlankAsBlank. Inputs empty, null, numeric respectively used Num__c=0 and blank Text__c; Num__c=null and Text__c=null; Num__c=1.25 and Text__c='12.5'. org.tsv rows 2–13 retain only queried formula values. Overprecision, rounding policy at the output boundary, formula evaluation APIs, and other output types were not measured.

Supplementary source and transport API 62.0 and 67.0 anonymous and named controls appear in supplement.tsv rows 2–25. Each queried formula uses BlankAsBlank: Num__c+1 at Number scales 0, 2, 3 and Currency scale 2, plus BLANKVALUE(Num__c,7)+1 and IF(ISBLANK(Num__c),7,Num__c)+1 at Number scale 2. Non-tie values, null and explicit fallbacks were observed; half ties were not part of this run.

The independent tie controls at source and transport APIs 62.0 and 67.0, on both routes, appear in ties.tsv rows 2–25. The Number scale-zero formula is Num__c+1 with BlankAsBlank. Signed half ties round away from zero in these observations.
